47: theorem repr_range : LinearMap.range (b.repr : M →ₗ[R] ι →₀ R) = Finsupp.supported R R univ := by
48:   rw [LinearEquiv.range, Finsupp.supported_univ]
49: 
50: theorem mem_span_repr_support (m : M) : m ∈ span R (b '' (b.repr m).support) :=
51:   (Finsupp.mem_span_image_iff_linearCombination _).2
52:     ⟨b.repr m, by simp [Finsupp.mem_supported_support]⟩
53: 
54: theorem repr_support_subset_of_mem_span (s : Set ι) {m : M}
55:     (hm : m ∈ span R (b '' s)) : ↑(b.repr m).support ⊆ s := by
56:   rcases (Finsupp.mem_span_image_iff_linearCombination _).1 hm with ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩
57:   rwa [repr_linearCombination, ← Finsupp.mem_supported R l]
58: 
59: theorem mem_span_image {m : M} {s : Set ι} : m ∈ span R (b '' s) ↔ ↑(b.repr m).support ⊆ s :=
60:   ⟨repr_support_subset_of_mem_span _ _, fun h ↦
61:     span_mono (Set.image_mono h) (mem_span_repr_support b _)⟩
62: 
63: @[simp]
64: theorem self_mem_span_image [Nontrivial R] {i : ι} {s : Set ι} :
65:     b i ∈ span R (b '' s) ↔ i ∈ s := by
66:   simp [mem_span_image, Finsupp.support_single]
67: 
68: protected theorem mem_span (x : M) : x ∈ span R (range b) :=
69:   span_mono (image_subset_range _ _) (mem_span_repr_support b x)
70: 
71: @[simp]
72: protected theorem span_eq : span R (range b) = ⊤ :=
73:   eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => b.mem_span x
74: 
75: theorem _root_.Submodule.eq_top_iff_forall_basis_mem {p : Submodule R M} :
76:     p = ⊤ ↔ ∀ i, b i ∈ p := by
77:   refine ⟨fun h ↦ by simp [h], fun h ↦ ?_⟩
78:   replace h : range b ⊆ p := by rintro - ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact h i
79:   simpa using span_mono (R := R) h

intro W hx hy hh
